name: Mona McAuley
occupation: Platte County clerk of district court (re-elected November 2026)
prior_offices: Platte County clerk of district court (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Mona McAuley is the Platte County clerk of district court and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official general election summary lists her with 3,211 votes.
